title: Pure U.A.
summary: Pure U.A. (Ultra Athlete) sports lineup, utilizing EARTH Warrior athletes that tag in and out of the hand by returning another U.A. monster you control to the hand. The strategy fields offensive powerhouses during your turn and substitutes in suffocating defensive disruptors on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: U.A. Midfielder is the core Level 4 Normal Summon that bounces a U.A. you control to immediately Special Summon a U.A. with a different name from your hand on either player's turn.
U.A. Stadium adds a U.A. monster from Deck to hand whenever a U.A. monster is Normal Summoned, and gives all your monsters 500 ATK whenever a U.A. is Special Summoned.
U.A. Hyper Stadium searches any U.A. monster or reveals a Field Spell to grant an additional U.A. Normal Summon by paying 1000 LP.
U.A. Signing Deal Special Summons any U.A. monster directly from your Deck with its effects negated and its Level matching your LP loss, giving instant tribute or tag material.

summary.title: Opening: Midfielder + Stadium
steps: Activate U.A. Stadium (or U.A. Hyper Stadium to search it).
Normal Summon U.A. Midfielder; Stadium triggers, searching U.A. Perfect Ace or U.A. Player Manager from your Deck to hand.
Return U.A. Midfielder to your hand to Special Summon U.A. Perfect Ace from your hand via its in-archetype tagging condition.
U.A. Stadium triggers on the Special Summon, boosting all monsters you control by 500 ATK.
During the opponent's turn, discard 1 card with U.A. Perfect Ace to negate and destroy an opponent's activated card or effect.

summary.title: Athletic Tag Mechanics & Defense
points: All high-Level U.A. monsters can Special Summon themselves from the hand once per turn by returning 1 face-up U.A. monster you control to the hand.
U.A. Perfect Ace discards 1 card once per turn during the opponent's turn to negate the activation of a Spell, Trap, or monster effect and destroy it.
U.A. Blockbacker changes the battle position and negates the effects of opponent monsters when they are Special Summoned.
U.A. Libero Spiker returns a Level 5 or higher U.A. monster from your hand to the Deck during the opponent's Main Phase to Special Summon a U.A. monster with a different name directly from your Deck.

U.A. Player Manager Special Summons itself from the hand whenever a U.A. monster is Normal or Special Summoned, and immediately either destroys 1 card on the field or negates the effects of all face-up non-U.A. monsters until the end of the turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff: Offensive Threats & Spells
points: U.A. Mighty Slugger completely shuts down all opponent card and effect activations until the end of the Damage Step whenever it attacks.
U.A. Dreadnought Dunker inflicts piercing battle damage and targets and destroys 1 card on the field whenever it inflicts battle damage.
U.A. Penalty Box banishes an opponent's monster at the start of damage calculation when battling a U.A. monster, and banishes itself from the GY to search any U.A. Spell Card.
U.A. Locker Room recovers a U.A. monster from field or GY to hand, gaining LP and shuffling U.A. cards into the Deck to draw fresh resources.
U.A. Man of the Match triggers when a U.A. monster destroys an opponent monster or inflicts battle damage, swarming U.A. monsters from hand and GY in Defense Position.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: F.A. crossover cards are left out of this build to focus entirely on pure U.A. warrior synergy and the archetype's dedicated tagging field spells.
